    r['summary']={'samples':len(accel),'duration_s':sum(intervals),'mean_accel_mss':[statistics.mean(a[k] for a in accel) for k in range(3)],'accel_norm_mean_mss':statistics.mean(norms),'accel_norm_std_mss':statistics.pstdev(norms),'accel_norm_minmax_mss':[min(norms),max(norms)],'mean_gyro_dps':[statistics.mean(g[k] for g in gyro) for k in range(3)],'std_gyro_dps':[statistics.pstdev(g[k] for g in gyro) for k in range(3)],'max_gyro_norm_dps':max(math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in g)) for g in gyro),'unique_accel_triplets':len(set(tuple(s['accel_raw']) for s in r['samples'])),'unique_gyro_triplets':len(set(tuple(s['gyro_raw']) for s in r['samples'])),'mean_poll_interval_s':statistics.mean(intervals),'max_poll_interval_s':max(intervals),'zero_sensor_tick_steps':sum(v==0 for v in tick_steps),'minmax_sensor_tick_steps':[min(tick_steps),max(tick_steps)],'saturated_accel_samples':sum(any(abs(v)>=32760 for v in s['accel_raw']) for s in r['samples']),'saturated_gyro_samples':sum(any(abs(v)>=32760 for v in s['gyro_raw']) for s in r['samples'])}

finally:
